name: Icpc2ToIcd10
title: ICPC-2 to ICD-10 (Danish, from KiAP)
description: ICPC-2 to Danish ICD-10/SKS mappings from KiAP ICPC-2-DK 4.4, [ICPC_v4_4_20260629.accdb](https://web.kiap.dk/resources/files/icpc/systemhuse/ICPC_v4_4_20260629.accdb), table ICPCKON2-v4_4_20260501. Uses KiAP's forward ICPCKON2 register, not an inversion or union of the separate ICD10-ICPC register. Includes mappings valid on the source release date 2026-06-29; creation and closing dates are taken from the first and last eight digits of Gyldig fra dato. The closing date is exclusive. International ICD-10, Danish extensions, and SKS-only targets are emitted in separate groups under their own systems. KiAP's preferred/additional match flag (Udl) is retained in target comments. Relationships are 'relatedto': neither mapping count nor the preferred-match flag is treated as a clinical equivalence assertion. Source and target labels use KiAP Danish texts, with whitespace normalized. Generated by scripts/icpc2_icd10_conceptmap.py. Version and date identify the KiAP release. Source history note: A01/DR521: malformed last-change date in 20240701206010125000101; intact validity endpoints used.
copyright: ICPC-2 is copyright WONCA (World Organization of Family Doctors). DSAM (Danish College of General Practitioners) holds and administers the Danish rights to ICPC-2-DK, which is maintained by KiAP. Use and redistribution of this content are subject to the applicable WONCA and DSAM licensing terms; this ConceptMap grants no additional rights. See [DSAM rights and stewardship information](https://www.dsam.dk/forskning-og-kvalitet/icpc) and [KiAP ICPC-2-DK information](https://www.kiap.dk/praksis/icpc-2). The containing package's CC0 license does not override these source rights or licensing terms.
